title: International Diversification
summary: Ben Felix rebuts common arguments for holding only US stocks, such as past outperformance and international revenue exposure. He supports the case for international diversification with cited academic research.
why: Cited in investing threads as a research-backed argument for diversifying beyond US equities, with sources in the description.
